actuator.revision: RS series product specification 2026-09-17; RS06 CAN manual 260713

electrical.phase_resistance_basis: Equivalent-wye inference from manufacturer line resistance; actual winding connection unspecified

performance.continuous_torque_basis: Published 8 Nm continuous stall rating; robot cooling unverified

vendor_curve.heat_sink_basis: Explicit for rotating tests; stall table does not restate all conditions

thermal.basis: Unmeasured thermal resistance/capacitance; equivalent-wye electrical inference; indicative only

stand.description: All four feet planted; RS06 loaded standing configuration.

walk.description: One foot swings at a time; reduced lift and longer support for RS06 stall limits at0.15m/s.

trot.description: Diagonal pairs; tuned on flat ground at0.30 and0.50m/s.

pace.description: Experimental lateral pairs; unvalidated for the new configuration.

bound.description: Experimental front/rear pairs; unvalidated for the new configuration.

cases.torque_velocity_pairing: Applied force with velocity at start of each implicitfast physics step
